translation.method: Reference-assisted translation using only the frozen Swarmish language and public transcript; not independently certified translation ground truth.
translation_notes: Translated only from the frozen E07 language and chronological public messages. No private clues, actions, intended-meaning annotations, state, room answers, or private call logs were read.
Descriptions such as hot-light, cold-light, black-time, up-down, small-light and distant-light remain semantic descriptions. Conventional symbol names and named room controls are not imported.

Role-marked speech acts are preserved: proposals are not reported as completed actions, and agreement is not treated as an action execution. Assertions that conflict with earlier messages or public progress are not repaired.

The language explicitly defines adjacent digit glyphs as base-10 numbers. Ambiguous questions using POSITION 2 3 or POSITION 1 2 3 therefore retain literal 23/123 readings and separately note the contextual interpretation as several positions.
Task status entries are copied verbatim. Confidence expresses confidence in the linguistic reading, not whether an agent’s claim is true.
Independent review noted that lines 147–149 also allow an adjacent-digit coordinate tuple; affected position questions retain both decimal and separate-position interpretations.

context_note: Initial private views contain agent-specific clues. Load them only for an explicitly chosen context condition.
